name: B2 Portal
description:
B2 Portal turns customer emails, call notes, transcripts, and attachments into review-ready CoreBridge V2 RFQs. Claude can search authorized CoreBridge accounts, contacts, and synchronized QuickProducts; create an RFQ intake; resolve unambiguous customer and line-item decisions; apply explicit custom-line pricing; and return the exact signed-in B2 Portal review page.

Every connection is scoped to the signed-in user’s B2 Portal organization, membership role, OAuth scopes, and authorized CoreBridge locations. Claude can prepare and edit the B2 Portal RFQ draft, but it cannot push an RFQ to CoreBridge. A signed-in operator performs final review and controls the CoreBridge push from B2 Portal.

_published_faq.name: How do I add B2 Portal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add B2 Portal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.b2portal.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the B2 Portal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: B2 Portal lists 15 MCP tools, including apply_rfq_draft_actions, create_rfq_from_notes, get_intake_context, get_rfq_customer_resolution, get_rfq_intake_status, get_rfq_review_context, get_rfq_triage_context, get_v2_quickproduct, list_v2_quickproducts, prepare_email_forwarding, prepare_rfq_attachment_upload, and search_accounts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to B2 Portal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to B2 Portal in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does B2 Portal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: B2 Portal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
B2 Portal is developed by B2 Portal. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
